newsitem.title: USA: SunRiver holder seeks chairman resignation.
newsitem.headline: SunRiver holder seeks chairman resignation.

text.p: SunRiver Corp said on Thursday its majority stockholder, the SunRiver Group Inc, has requested the resignation of Chairman Gerald Youngblood, an increase in the size of the board to seven members, and the election of three SunRiver Group designees to the board.

SunRiver Group began action to effect these changes by voting its common stock and has said it is prepared to take further action, subject to legal requirements, if its requests were not met, SunRiver said.
Management and SunRiver Group representatives were holding talks on the matter, the company said.

SunRiver said discussions also included changes in other key SunRiver and TradeWave Corp management personnel, with a view toward a cooperative transition. TradeWave is wholly-owned subsidiary of SunRiver.
The company was not immediately available for futher comment.
